checks.text: The page shows the heading "IP Subnet Calculator".

Typing "192.168.1.0" in the field labelled "IP Address" and "24" in the field labelled "Prefix Length" and clicking "Calculate" shows "Network: 192.168.1.0", "Broadcast: 192.168.1.255", and "Usable Hosts: 254" in the result summary.
After the calculation in A2, the breakdown table shows a row with "Subnet Mask" and "255.255.255.0", and a row with "First Usable" and "192.168.1.1".

Typing "10.0.0.0" in the field labelled "IP Address" and "8" in the field labelled "Prefix Length" and clicking "Calculate" shows "Network: 10.0.0.0", "Broadcast: 10.255.255.255", and "Usable Hosts: 16777214".

Typing "192.168.1.100" in the field labelled "IP Address" and "24" in the field labelled "Prefix Length" and clicking "Calculate" shows "Network: 192.168.1.0", "Broadcast: 192.168.1.255", and "Usable Hosts: 254".
Typing "abc" in the field labelled "IP Address" and clicking "Calculate" shows the error message "Invalid IP address" and no result summary is displayed.
After calculating 192.168.1.0/24, clicking the button "Save to List" adds an item to the list containing "192.168.1.0/24" and "254 hosts".
With a saved item "192.168.1.0/24" in the list, clicking the button "Delete 192.168.1.0/24" removes the item from the list.
Reload keeps the saved list item "192.168.1.0/24" and "254 hosts" after reloading the page.
